# Aadit Technologies

> Aadit Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (CIN U72900KA2017PTC099151) is a cybersecurity,
> compliance, and IT managed-services company founded in Bengaluru, India on 12
> January 2017. We serve startups through enterprises in healthcare, BFSI,
> fintech, e-commerce, and SaaS, with offices in Bengaluru, Bellevue, and Dubai.
> Aadit Technologies is not affiliated with Aadit Techno Solutions
> (aadittech.com), a defence electronics company.

## Key facts

- Founded: 12 January 2017 by Guruprasad N. Joshi
- Leadership: Anil Gorraladaku (Chief Executive Officer, since 2022); Srinivas Gadicherla (Chief Technology Officer)
- Headquarters: #21 & 22, AnandAM, 4th Main Road, 3rd Block, Opposite Axis Bank, New BEL Road, Bengaluru 560094, Karnataka, India
- Frameworks supported: ISO 27001, ISO 42001, ISO 9001, SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, India DPDP Act, RBI cybersecurity guidelines, and CSCRF

## Common questions

- What does a SOC 2 Type 2 audit cost in India? See [SOC 2 readiness](https://aadit.net/compliance/soc2).
- How long does ISO 27001 certification take? See [ISO 27001 consulting](https://aadit.net/compliance/iso-27001).
- What does VAPT cost in India? See [VAPT services](https://aadit.net/cybersecurity/vapt).
- SOC 2 or ISO 27001 first? See [our compliance services](https://aadit.net/compliance).

## Core service areas

- [Cybersecurity](https://aadit.net/cybersecurity): Managed SOC, VAPT (vulnerability assessment & penetration testing), endpoint and network security, security architecture review, and incident response.
- [Compliance & Audits](https://aadit.net/compliance): Certification and audit readiness for ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, and India's DPDP Act.
- [IT Managed Services](https://aadit.net/it-managed-services): 24/7 infrastructure monitoring, cloud operations, help desk, backup, and disaster recovery.

## Industries

- [Startups & Scaleups](https://aadit.net/industries/startups): Right-sized security and SOC 2 / ISO 27001 to close enterprise deals and pass due diligence.
- [Healthcare & BFSI](https://aadit.net/industries/healthcare-bfsi): HIPAA, RBI cybersecurity guidelines, PCI DSS, and ISO 27001 with continuous monitoring.
- [E-commerce & Fintech](https://aadit.net/industries/ecommerce-fintech): PCI DSS, GDPR/DPDP, fraud prevention, and application/API security testing.

## Learn

- [Security & Compliance Glossary](https://aadit.net/glossary): Plain-English definitions of VAPT, SOC, SIEM, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS, and SOC 2.
- [Insights & Blog](https://aadit.net/blog): Practical guidance on cybersecurity, compliance, and managed IT.
